title: Willmore Energy Estimates for Klein Bottles
summary: In this note, we provide an estimate for the Willmore energy of Klein bottles in $\mathbb R^N$, building on the ideas of Li-Yau and Montiel-Ros for $2$-tori. In particular, we prove that the Willmore energy $\mathcal{W}(φ)> 6π$ for any conformal branched immersion $φ:\mathbb{K}^2_b\rightarrow \mathbb R^N$, where $\mathbb{K}^2_b$ is a flat Klein bottle with $0.350\lesssim b \lesssim 0.755$.
